"Arikara" is the culmination of an ominous task given by Magatha Grimtotem in Thunder Bluff. Warning that an ancient wind serpent may be stalking High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, the elder shaman sends Horde adventurers to summon and slay the beast upon the burial spires of Thousand Needles.

After securing refined Incendia powder, Magatha Grimtotem enchants the reagent to serve as a summoning catalyst. She warns that ancient tauren traditions have shifted too rapidly under the new Horde alliance, provoking the vengeance of Arikara, a ferocious wind serpent spirit. Magatha directs heroes southward into the windswept canyon of Thousand Needles, instructing them to throw the powder onto a ritual pyre situated among the elevated burial sites of Darkcloud Pinnacle.

Upon slaying the serpent on the burial needle and claiming its skin, adventurers deliver the remains to Motega Firemane at Whitereach Post. Rather than relief, Motega expresses genuine bewilderment. He finds it unbelievable that a primal spirit like Arikara would harbor malice toward Cairne Bloodhoof. Yet, unwilling to openly question Magatha's status as the tribe's most powerful shaman, Motega sets aside his suspicions and rewards the champion for protecting the chieftain.

In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon enlists Horde adventurers to gather toxic fungi from an overrun farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills. These virulent Mudsnout Blossoms serve as vital raw material for the Royal Apothecary Society's grim chemical experimentation. The resulting concoction is meant to aid Lady Sylvanas's long-term design to eradicate both the living and the Scourge.

While the Scourge ravages the north and the Alliance clings to towns like Southshore, the Forsaken pursue their own calculated solution: the development of a tailored, lethal plague. Operating out of Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon labors under the mandate of the Dark Lady. Though personally cynical about the tedious toil of alchemy, Lydon diligently gathers potent organic toxins from the surrounding countryside to brew elixirs capable of speeding along the mutual destruction of Sylvanas's enemies.

South of Tarren Mill and east of the river lies Nethander Stead, an abandoned human farmstead now overrun by the vicious Mudsnout gnolls. Amid the filth and neglected soil, strange and foul-smelling mushrooms known as Mudsnout Blossoms flourish. These large, pungent growths hold concentrated organic poisons prized by the Royal Apothecary Society. Procuring them requires cutting through gnoll packs or quietly weaving past their ramshackle camps.

Apothecary Lydon is an alchemist of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed at Tarren Mill in Hillsbrad Foothills. Working on behalf of Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, his duties focus on refining lethal mixtures and developing a new plague to defeat both living mortals and the Scourge.

Following a deadly centaur ambush on a merchant caravan in Thousand Needles, the goblin tinkerer Wizlo Bearingshiner was left as the sole survivor. Desperate to reclaim his prized invention, he hires adventurers to breach the wreckage, unlock an iron cage, and wrest the gizmo from the neck of a fearsome caged predator.

Caravans venturing beneath the towering sandstone spires of Thousand Needles run a perilous gauntlet. Hostile centaur prowl the canyon floor, fiercely guarding their territory and raiding any travelers bold enough to pass through. When one such trade caravan was overrun just north of Whitereach Post, the centaur slaughtered the travelers and plundered the wagons, leaving only the goblin Wizlo Bearingshiner to limp back to safety.

In the chaos of the raid, the centaur looted nearly every valuable scrap, but they gave one ruined wagon a wide berth. Bound inside a sturdy transport cage was a ferocious, enraged panther with Wizlo's prized hypercapacitor gizmo fastened directly around its neck. Daunted by the predator's snarling fury, the centaur abandoned the cage intact, forcing Wizlo to entrust its key to brave mercenaries capable of slaying the beast and reclaiming his gadget.

True to goblin fashion, Wizlo's passion for mechanical wonder often outpaces practical understanding. Despite hailing the hypercapacitor gizmo as his finest creation and risking lives to retrieve it from the clutches of an apex predator, he admits upon its return that he still has to tinker with it to figure out what it actually does.
